provenance.calculationMethod: TP/FP/FN computed by dynamically re-running RuleExecutionEngine.analyzeFile against every file in benchmarks/testbed and diffing the resulting diagnostics against benchmarks/ground-truth.json (exact filePath+ruleId match). Precision = TP/(TP+FP), Recall = TP/(TP+FN), F1 = 2*P*R/(P+R). No cached or hand-typed confusion matrix is used at any step.

datasetClassification.groundTruthTestbed: 147 LOC across the fixture files in benchmarks/testbed, scored against benchmarks/ground-truth.json
datasetClassification.humanStudyStatusSource: research/analysis/usability-results.json (see that file for real participant count / collection status — never this artifact)
